title: canary-rollout-personal-scratchpad-isabella-martin
content:
Goal: quick personal scratchpad for the next canary (v1.12.0 -> v1.13.0). Note: this is informal - capture assumptions / TODOs / questions I need to verify before we lock the rollout plan.

High-level plan (working):
- Target: push v1.13.0 (includes kernel change X, cache prewarming, quantized float16 path)
- Canary cohort: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~48-72h if healthy
- Cohorts defined by routing policy: by user tier then hash-based routing (rollout flag in routing table)
- Pinning: default hosted model remains v1.12.0; pin paid-enterprise routes to v1.13.0 only after 50% successful canary and sign-off

Metrics / health checks (things to validate during each step):
- p50/p95 latency: no more than +15ms from baseline for p50, +25ms for p95 (baseline = last 7d median for route/model)
- Error rate: request errors (5xx) <= 0.1% absolute increase over baseline AND no spike >0.5% in any 10m window
- Token generation correctness: run smoke evals (10 seed prompts) per model variant; fuzz tests for hallucination regressions
- Cost: tokens/sec and GPU utilization - ensure no regressive >10% on throughput for same cost class
- KV cache hit rate: shouldn't drop by >5% (because of kernel change there is some risk)
- Memory / OOM: zero OOMs in canary pool; any OOM -> immediate rollback
- Autoscaler behavior: confirm no thrashing during traffic ramps

Runbook / checklist (pre-rollout):
- [ ] Confirm PR 442 merged + build artifact in GCR (image tag: rwd/serving:v1.13.0)
- [ ] Upload model artifacts and quantized variants to model-repo (paths + checksum)
- [ ] Verify model-variant compatibility matrix (CPU/GPU/quantization) in Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-1234)
- [ ] Update routing policy config in staging; test with canary flag locally
- [ ] Prewarm KV cache on canary pool: run warmup script (scripts/warmup/kv_warm.py) with top-100 prefixes for target routes
- [ ] Smoke test on staging (latency, small eval set) - capture screenshots/logs
- [ ] Notify #release-rollout Slack with rollout window and pager on-call

Rollout steps (execution):
- Step 0: create canary pool (dedicated nodes) with v1.13.0 image; link to routing policy 
- Step 1: route 1% traffic for 30m. Monitor key metrics (error, latency, mem). If green -> proceed. If amber -> hold and investigate, consult SRE + ML leads. If red -> rollback to v1.12.0 and open incident meta ticket.
- Step 2: increase to 5% for 1h; run full smoke evals and larger sample correctness tests (100 prompts)
- Step 3: 20% for 4h with continuous monitoring; run extended perf eval (throughput/batch sizing)
- Step 4: 50% for 12h; invite product to validate customer-facing behavior on dedicated routes
- Step 5: 100% if no regressions after 24h at 50%

Rollback criteria (immediate rollback triggers):
- >0.5% absolute increase in 5xx for any 10m window OR sustained >0.2% increase over 1h
- p95 latency regression >40ms absolute
- Any OOMs / node crashes in canary pool
- Major correctness regression found by smoke evals (e.g., critical hallucination or safety failure)

Post-rollout steps:
- [ ] Tag release in GitHub + create release note draft
- [ ] Update model pinning doc and default routing mappings
- [ ] Schedule postmortem or retrospective if any anomalies occurred
- [ ] Notify customers (if enterprise impacted/pinned) via CS templates

Notes / unknowns / questions: 
- Need to verify kernel change X interacts with KV cache warmup timing - Samir to run dedicated microbench with prefix sizes 10/100/1k and capture KV hit curves
- Does quantized path fall back gracefully to full-fp on specific ops? add a test for edge-case ops (layernorm, rotary)
- Confirm observability: traces should include model-version tag; if not, add quick patch to tracer metadata to include model_version and quant_variant
- Should we set a short-term feature-flag to allow immediate pinning per-customer from Console if customers call support? (ask product)

Temporary notes to self: 
- If rollout begins during peak APAC hours, consider slower ramp (double observation windows)
- Keep management loop small: coordinate with Noah (SRE), Samir (runtime), Maya (ML lead)
- Save artifact IDs in linked_artifacts after finalize

Quick commands I usually run: 
- kubectl get pods -n canary -l app=serving-runtime -o wide
- ./scripts/observe/metric_alerts.sh JIRA-RELEASE-789
- python scripts/warmup/kv_warm.py --model model-a --topk 100 --pool canary

References / tickets to cross-check: 
- JIRA-RELEASE-789 = rollout epic; contains subtasks for infra + build
- github PR 442 = kernel + quant changes (watch the perf comments)
- CONFLUENCE-1234 = canary playbook (formalized steps)

TODO (short list):
- [ ] Get sign-off from product (Maya) on customer-visible risk matrix
- [ ] Samir: run microbench KV experiments and paste results here
- [ ] Noah: confirm canary pool autoscaling policy and alert thresholds
- [ ] Draft release notes skeleton (copy from last release)

Last checked: 2026-02-25 - everything above is my working snapshot.

End of scratchpad.
